data.text: Prevent fake profiles with instant identity checks, age verification, selfie matching, and document verification at signup and high-risk actions.
Verify high-value users, reduce chargebacks, detect fraudulent upgrades, and automate refunds and payouts for premium subscription models.
Enable compliant onboarding of creators, automated earnings payouts, identity checks, and fraud-resistant monetisation for your platform.
Secure real-time interactions with continuous fraud monitoring, impersonation checks, and payout automation for hosts and live streamers.
Ensure trust in smaller communities with lightweight KYC, abuse prevention, and verified user badges for enhanced safety.
Support compliant onboarding, fraud prevention, and payouts across geographies with scalable verification workflows for global reach.
